body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Create a temporary low earthen screen in the space until the start of your next turn. It grants +1 cover bonus across it, has 1 Wound and 0 Resilience, and vanishes when destroyed.

surges.html: Create the screen in an adjacent space instead after seeing the roll.
A willing creature adjacent to it reduces its next incoming ranged Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Earth Thread
rider.html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.
